title: Range

reason.frames: The video does not say its frame rate.

time.help: Type H:MM:SS.mmm, MM:SS or seconds. An empty End encodes to the end of the source.
time.invalid: This is not a time: type H:MM:SS.mmm, MM:SS or seconds.

frames.help: The first frame is 0. The To frame is not encoded: 0 to 25 is the first 25 frames. An empty To encodes to the end of the source.
frames.invalid: This is not a frame number: type a whole number from 0.

fileOnly: A group has no range: this range is for the shown file only.
